headline: Amazon's $25B Anthropic bet concentrates power — Enslaved God climbs
body: One big deal dominated the day. Amazon will invest $5B now and up to $20B later in Anthropic, and Anthropic commits more than $100B to Amazon's cloud for up to 5 GW of compute over a decade. Two world factors moved. Power Concentration rose, because frontier AI is pooling inside a few giant partnerships; and Capability Velocity rose, because that much compute means faster progress. Endings that need one powerful owner gained: Enslaved God, where a boxed superintelligence serves whoever holds the keys, and Zookeeper, where a single power controls a dominant AI. Benevolent Dictator also rose. Endings built on spread-out power lost ground, mainly Libertarian Utopia and Egalitarian Utopia. Horizon Balance fell to +3.05, down 0.35, and two endings swapped places.
movers_note: Enslaved God +0.9, Zookeeper +0.7 and Libertarian Utopia -0.6, all from the Amazon–Anthropic investment deal (+0.89, +0.65 and -0.59).
